items.title: MECH-477 dual-system arbitration falsifier, repaired aggregation (empty-cell 0.0 -> None fix; supersedes 811)
items.note: BUG-FIX RE-RUN of V3-EXQ-811 (repaired instrument, same question), routed by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-811_2026-07-24.{md,json} (confirmed, user-cleared 2026-07-24) Section 9/10. 811's own manifest self-routed FAIL/substrate_not_ready_requeue on all three non-vacuity readiness gates (full_score_range_non_degenerate, habit_score_range_non_degenerate, habit_score_distinct_fraction) even though its load-bearing C1 criterion (C1_recruitment_delta_greater_with_arbitrator) passed cleanly (Cohen's d 0.999 ON vs -0.158 OFF, 6/7 divergent seeds ON-greater) and every arbitration-liveness/coupling check read at or near 100%. ROOT CAUSE: 20/128 cells (15.6%, skewed toward novel/arb_on) scored zero E3 ticks, and the empty-cell default for the three range/distinctness fields in experiments/_lib/baselines/mech477_dualsystem_arbitration.py was 0.0 -- indistinguishable from a genuine degenerate reading of exactly zero -- instead of None, which the adjacent recruitment_rate field already correctly defaults to (and which downstream filters out). The worst-case-across-cells aggregation (_worst(), a deliberate true min so no cell hides inside an in-band mean) then propagated the spurious 0.0 through every aggregation level, zeroing the whole run's readiness verdict for BOTH arms regardless of how the other 84% of cells read. The autopsy manually re-derived a clean PASS from 811's own manifest (excluding zero-tick cells): full range 0.0022, habit range 9.34e-6, habit distinct fraction 0.875, all three clearing their floors -- no new run was needed for 811's OWN verdict. THE FIX (lineage module only, driver unchanged): the three empty-cell defaults now propagate None through all three aggregation levels (per-probe, per-condition, per-arm-per-seed) via two new helpers (_worst_or_none / _mean_or_none) mirroring recruitment_rate's existing convention; the driver's own _worst() already filtered None correctly and needed no change. recommended_substrate_queue_entry.action = "none" per the autopsy -- SD-081 works as designed, this was a script-level aggregation bug, not a substrate gap. Verified: unit-tested both helpers directly (mixed None/float lists, all-None, empty) and probe_layout() with n_episodes=0 (forces a genuine zero-tick cell) -- confirms None now propagates where 0.0 used to. Full driver otherwise byte-identical to 811 (same pre-registered thresholds, schedule, arms, claim tags); manifest carries supersedes="v3_exq_811_mech477_dualsystem_arbitration_falsifier". GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): not applicable in the reanalysis-skips-a-run sense -- the autopsy's own manual re-derivation already answers 811's verdict without a new run; this run exists per the autopsy's explicit repair routing so a clean manifest self-routes correctly going forward without hand re-derivation, not to recover data already recoverable. Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): does not fire -- neither 786, 786a, nor 811's corrected reading carries recommended_epistemic_category=substrate_ceiling for MECH-477 or MECH-163. Readiness (Step 2.5): SD-081 (e3.dualsystem_uncertainty_arbitration) IMPLEMENTED in ree-v3/CLAUDE.md, unchanged since 811. VALIDATION: py_compile OK; ASCII-clean; validate_experiments.py --strict --paths OK (1 OK, 0 warnings of any kind); dry-run smoke PASS end-to-end (2 seeds x 2 arms, all 4 cells fingerprinted reuse-eligible, verdict lines printed correctly, [train] ep N/M progress instrumentation confirmed against the shared warmup_train helper); validate_recording.py --strict OK on the dry-run manifest (recording_schema rec/v1, substrate_hash, machine_class darwin-arm64-py3.13-torch2.12.0, elapsed_seconds, config, seeds all present). Toy-scale dry run reads FAIL/non_contributory/substrate_not_ready_requeue as expected (SEM_MIN_N=3 > 2 dry-run seeds, so the AUC/SEM-gated preconditions cannot pass at smoke scale regardless of the fix) -- this is the same non-gating smoke behaviour 811's own queue note documented. Queued from a throwaway detached worktree off origin/main (shared ree-v3 checkout was not touched; other sessions' in-flight edits to v3_exq_724/734 and untracked _lib files left undisturbed).

items.title: MECH-163 dual-system recruitment (leg 1) -- DV-degeneracy repair: HABIT_DEPTH=2 read + habit-vector readiness gates (V3-EXQ-811 precedent)
items.note: REPAIRS V3-EXQ-786a's DV degeneracy (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-786a_2026-07-24_dv_degeneracy, confirmed, user-adjudicated 2026-07-24 -- weakens WITHDRAWN, MECH-163 leg (1) reverted to experimentally untested). 786a's recruitment DV computed 'first_step_score' from world_seq[:, :1, :] -- index 0 is the pre-action state, shared by every candidate before any trajectory diverges, so the vector was CONSTANT (verified: n_unique=1 across all 32 candidates, every tick). recruitment = 1 - spearman(full, first) therefore compared the real ranking against a constant vector, which does not degrade to 'no signal' but produces NOISE with a specific distribution (200-draw simulation: mean 1.0173 sd 0.1871) because a double-argsort of a constant array is a non-zero-variance stable-sort permutation -- 786a's manifest recruitment_rate 1.01725 matched that simulated noise to 5 significant figures. 786a's own readiness gate (candidate_score_range_non_degenerate) checked only the FULL-HORIZON range, never the first-step vector, so the degenerate case passed readiness cleanly. FIX, adopted verbatim from the V3-EXQ-811 precedent (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-811_2026-07-24): (1) HABIT_DEPTH=2 instead of the degenerate depth-1 read -- depth 0 is the shared pre-action state, depth 2 is the first depth at which candidates can differ; (2) TWO NEW readiness preconditions gating the habit-depth vector's OWN cross-candidate range and distinct-value fraction (habit_score_range_non_degenerate, habit_score_distinct_fraction_non_degenerate), alongside the renamed full_score_range_non_degenerate (786a's original, unchanged); (3) gated AT THE POINT OF COMPUTATION -- a tick counts toward recruitment_rate only when BOTH the full-horizon AND habit-depth ranges clear the floor, a second line of defence beyond the readiness preconditions; (4) WORST-CASE (min), None-safe aggregation throughout -- a zero-scored-tick cell contributes None and is excluded from every min, never coerced to a spurious 0.0. Point (4) additionally FIXES a bug 811's OWN implementation shipped (its failure_autopsy found this): 811's min_full_score_range / min_habit_score_range / min_habit_distinct_frac fields defaulted an empty cell to 0.0 instead of None (unlike its correctly-None-defaulted recruitment_rate), so a single empty cell could zero the whole run's readiness verdict. This script's _worst() helper follows the correct None-exclude pattern throughout, so it does not reintroduce that sibling defect while fixing the DV-degeneracy one. Design refinement made during authoring (not in 811's precedent): habit_score_distinct_frac is deliberately EXCLUDED from the check_degeneracy cross-seed self-report (kept only as a P0 gating precondition) -- it is a coarsely quantized statistic (multiples of 1/32) sitting near its ceiling by design, so ties across seeds at the same discrete value are the expected healthy outcome, not a degeneracy signature; including it caused a spurious non_degenerate: false flag in this script's own --dry-run smoke (two seeds tied at 0.96875) with no scientific content, fixed before queuing. full_score_range and habit_score_range (continuous quantities) remain in check_degeneracy, mirroring 786a's own candidate_score_range entry. Everything else held IDENTICAL to 786a: familiar/novel env kwargs (10/3/5/2 vs 14/7/2/5), drift off in both, n=8 seeds, the AUC manipulation-check bar (substantive >=0.70 + above-chance SEM leg >0.50), the calibrated familiarity query/update bandwidth pair 0.20/1.0 pinned by the experiment (not read from config), and the power-derived load-bearing bar (mean-SEM > 0.02 AND Cohen's d >= 0.8) -- that power calculation was derived from V3-EXQ-786's raw noise SD (0.0261), not from 786a's degenerate DV, so it carries forward unmodified. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout is the per-seed novel-minus-familiar recruitment delta from a non-degenerate depth-2-vs-full-horizon read, WITHOUT an explicit arbitrator. Checked V3-EXQ-811's arb_off arm as a candidate substitute -- NOT recoverable: 811's OFF arm runs at curiosity_weight=0.05 (required for the SD-081 arbitrator's u_habit path), a materially different config from this experiment's curiosity_weight=0 (required here for CEM-scorer non-circularity, per the _familiarity docstring, unchanged from 786a), and both the 786a and 811 autopsies explicitly conclude 811 tests a different (though related) question -- whether an EXPLICIT ARBITRATOR (MECH-477) produces differential recruitment -- and does not substitute for this bare-dual-pathway leg-(1) retest. RE-DERIVE BRAKE (Step 2.5b): count 0 for MECH-163 -- none of the 786, 786a, or 811 autopsies record recommended_epistemic_category: substrate_ceiling for this claim (all measurement_test_design_defect); brake does not fire. SUBSTRATE READINESS (Step 2.5): no new substrate dependency -- HABIT_DEPTH is a script-local slicing constant read directly via agent.residue_field.evaluate_trajectory, not a cfg.e3 flag; the substrate this script depends on (residue_field, generate_trajectories, FamiliarityTracker) is identical to 786a's and already validated in production by both 786a's and 811's runs. SMOKE: validate_experiments --strict OK (0 warnings, 0 backlog flags). --dry-run PASS end-to-end (2 seeds x 2 conditions), re-run twice: once against the local checkout, once against origin/main HEAD 279ac2b inside the throwaway landing worktree (byte-identical script) to confirm the substrate this run will actually execute against. Both runs: exit 0, habit_score_range_non_degenerate and habit_score_distinct_fraction_non_degenerate both MET at toy scale (measured range ~2e-3-2e-2, distinct-fraction ~0.97) -- confirming the depth-2 read is genuinely non-constant, unlike 786a's structurally-constant depth-1 read. AUC manipulation check correctly misses at toy scale (2 practice episodes vs the real 30, undertrained encoder) and self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue -- expected smoke behaviour, unrelated to the DV fix, matching 786a's own toy-scale dry-run shape. non_degenerate: True after the check_degeneracy refinement (was False before, on the quantization artifact described above).

EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE=diagnostic, claim_ids=[MECH-448] retained for audit traceability only -- with no ARM_ON present this run cannot itself move MECH-448's evidence (evidence_direction=non_contributory on both branches); it exists solely to resolve or further characterize 689i's one blocked gate. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): reanalysis_query.py --readout selected_action_class_entropy_mm --claim MECH-448 found only 689i itself (substrate_hash 3c7dfea1b222ecdf...) carrying this readout at n=4 -- the decisive readout (a reliable n=12 read plus the gap_norm/T_eff/pool-homogeneity diagnostics) is not recoverable from any recorded manifest -> run. items.title: P-comp: MECH-448 demotion x MECH-449 Go/No-Go composition at PER-COMMITMENT committed-class entropy (2x2 diagnostic; 699 instrument repair -- fresh-select DV, levers_compound withdrawn)
items.note: INSTRUMENT REPAIR of V3-EXQ-699, routed by REE_assembly/evidence/planning/failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-699_2026-07-20.json (REE_assembly ac2fb64028). LETTER not a new number: the scientific question is UNCHANGED (does MECH-448 demotion compose with MECH-449 Go/No-Go at the committed-class axis) and only the instrumentation was wrong, which CLAUDE.md's EXQ versioning rule puts squarely in the alphabetic-suffix case; the autopsy records a deliberate dissent from an earlier chip that asserted a new number, and cites the 708 -> 708a precedent for the same class of repair. WHAT STANDS from 699: the PASS and the whole C1 readiness battery -- its single load-bearing criterion is readiness-only, the C1e/C1f non-vacuity floors are literally 0.0, and the active-frac / frac_pre_ge2 gates saturate at exactly 1.0, so all seven preconditions are threshold-invariant to the defect. WHAT IS WITHDRAWN: the levers_compound composition finding. 699's primary DV committed_class_entropy_nats was accumulated at driver :882/:899 from int(action[0].argmax()) on the action RETURNED by agent.select_action, once per ENV STEP; on a non-E3 tick ree_core/agent.py:5430 returns the HELD action before e3.select() is reached. The DV was therefore hold-duration-weighted OCCUPANCY entropy standing in for the per-COMMITMENT construct both claims act on (they act at SELECTION). This is a CONSTRUCT MISMATCH, not staleness -- the diagnostics values were fresh (reassigned wholesale at e3_selector.py:2452); the READ was replicated by hold duration. The bias is ALIGNED with the hypothesis (ARM_OFF is the reference for every delta, and an unarmed agent perseverates longer, depressing its occupancy entropy and inflating every d_* including d_both), so no sign-check is available and the CORRECTED SIGN IS UNKNOWN. This is a WITHDRAWAL, NOT A REVERSAL: do not restate 'the levers compound' or 'safe to co-arm' in EITHER direction pending this run -- 699's own CANCEL branch was never ruled out by an uncontaminated measurement either. WHAT 699b CHANGES (autopsy routing requirements 1-8): (1) every per-selection quantity -- committed class, consumed-summary divergence, lateral_pfc bias, CRF state, and BOTH lever diagnostics -- is recorded only on a genuine fresh E3 selection; (2) n_fresh_select / n_latched / fresh_select_yield / replication_factor emitted per arm-seed, the single field whose absence made 699 unrecoverable (n_p2_ticks counts ENV STEPS and swings 3.8x within one seed); (3) BOTH readouts emitted and kept distinct -- committed_class_entropy_nats (PRIMARY, per-commitment, the DV the verdict reads) and occupancy_class_entropy_nats (699's DV verbatim) -- with the pre-registered composition rule applied to BOTH via _composition_verdict_from(), a matched-replay comparison over identical cells/seeds/thresholds differing only in sampling unit (the method used on the 663 driver at ree-v3 5433e3ab1c). The 663 replay bounded that defect at sub-1% but does NOT generalise here: 663's DV is a continuous magnitude whose replication is near-uniform across arms and cancels in the contrast, whereas an ENTROPY over a class histogram is reweighted directly by replication and these arms differ in HOLD DURATION, the very weighting quantity. The 699-instrumented verdict is DIAGNOSTIC CONTEXT ONLY, never a finding; (4) hold-duration mean/median/max/histogram per arm-seed, which directly tests the perseveration argument (ARM_OFF longest holds confirms it; flat bounds it); (5) selected_class_entropy_nats DROPPED -- under 699's instrumentation it equalled the primary DV to 6dp on ALL 12 arm-seeds and carried zero independent information; (6) C1 battery UNCHANGED in predicates and thresholds, the only change being the active-frac DENOMINATOR (now n_fresh_select, the honest denominator for a per-selection gate; the smoke confirms armed arms read exactly 1.0 and unarmed exactly 0.0, reproducing 699's saturation), plus ONE ADDED gate C1(g) fresh-selection sufficiency which 699 could not have had; (7) supersedes V3-EXQ-699 and V3-EXQ-699a on both the queue entry and the manifest; (8) recording core stamped via pack_writer -> manifest_core.stamp_recording_core. DELIBERATE DEVIATION from autopsy requirement 1 and the v3_exq_785a reference, documented in the module docstring: 699b does NOT null the two latches. Nulling _last_selected_trajectory CHANGES SUBSTRATE BEHAVIOUR -- post_action_update (e3_selector.py:3224) falls back to it when _committed_trajectory is None (the ARC-016 deadlock fix) and runs on EVERY step via update_residue (agent.py:8006), so nulling it silently skips running-variance updates and the prediction_error / dynamic_precision metrics on non-E3 ticks with no live commitment; in a COMPOSITION experiment that perturbs the selection dynamics under test and would make this a different experiment rather than a repaired instrument. Nulling last_score_diagnostics is None-safe but also not inert (agent.py:9660 would fall back to authority defaults on non-E3 ticks). Instead a private SENTINEL KEY is stamped into the diagnostics dict before every select_action: select() reassigns that dict WHOLESALE at e3_selector.py:2452 with no early return, so the key survives iff select() did not run; its sole ree_core reader (agent.py:9660) uses .get() with defaults and nothing iterates its keys, so the marker is fully INERT. Same guarantee, zero substrate perturbation. Because the two validate_experiments lints pattern-match on a literal `= None` clear, they fire as FALSE POSITIVES here; E3_DIAGNOSTICS_STALENESS_EXEMPT and E3_HOLD_WEIGHTED_READOUT_EXEMPT are set with that reason recorded verbatim in the script. They must NOT be read as '699b still carries the 699 defect' -- the opposite is true. KNOWN CAVEAT (pre-existing, INHERITED from 699, deliberately NOT silenced): validate_experiments emits an anchor-reachability WARN on the eight readiness preconditions (no assert_anchor_reachable guard). Not exempted, because it has not been discharged -- but empirically mitigated: V3-EXQ-699 MET all seven of these anchors on a real full-scale run, so they are demonstrably reachable rather than unmeetable-by-construction. Flagged for a separate follow-up. GOV-REUSE-1: the decisive readout (per-COMMITMENT committed-class entropy) exists in NO recorded manifest -- 699's is the occupancy variant and is the defect itself, 699a re-emits it unchanged, and no run in the corpus recorded n_fresh_select for this driver, so the replication factor cannot even be estimated post-hoc. Recoverability is explicitly false in the autopsy (no custom_information, no per-tick sink, metrics.json 53 chars, Phase-3 cloud transport carries manifest_bytes only -- thrice-confirmed with 785 and 708). NOT RECOVERABLE -> run. Re-derive brake CLEAR: MECH-448 and MECH-449 each have 0 prior substrate_ceiling / non_contributory autopsies. experiment_purpose=diagnostic; PROMOTES NOTHING, scoring-excluded. Design UNCHANGED from 699 (2x2 demotion {OFF,ON} x Go/No-Go {OFF,ON}, matched stack, 3 seeds x 4 arms, 350 ep/run). Inherits the precondition-declaration fix (ree-v3 0bfbb42, _min_arm_count) that 699a existed to exercise, since that fix is prospective and already on main. PRIORITY 28 = below the live MECH-457 / zworld-encoder front (30-55) but well above 699a's 5. 699a was priced at 5 on the reasoning that 'the scientific answer is already known, only the record needs repair'; that premise is now FALSE -- the answer is NOT known, levers_compound is withdrawn, and the composition gates the conversion_ceiling_campaign:FULLSTACK co-arming decision. IN-FLIGHT: V3-EXQ-699a was status=claimed by ree-cloud-3 since 2026-07-19T21:05:38Z (~600 est min) when 699b was queued; it is a FAITHFUL re-run of the unchanged 699 driver and will reproduce every defect above. The autopsy recommends dequeuing it via the coordinator, but that is the USER'S decision and was NOT taken by this session. If it completes, its manifest MUST carry the autopsy's evidence_quality_note verbatim, otherwise a cleanly-adjudicable levers_compound lands on the record and reads as CONFIRMATION of the finding withdrawn here -- the worst available outcome. VALIDATION: py_compile OK; validate_experiments --strict OK (0 stale-e3-diagnostics, 0 hold-weighted-readout, 0 precondition-recomputability warnings; 1 inherited anchor-reachability WARN as above); ASCII-clean (0 non-ASCII bytes); dry-run smoke PASS end-to-end (4 arms, 4 verdict lines at 1 seed, 12 at full scale; toy scale self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue as designed); fresh-gating verified live on the smoke manifest -- yield 0.47-0.78, replication 1.28-2.12, armed-arm demotion/nogo fracs EXACTLY 1.0 and unarmed EXACTLY 0.0 (reproducing 699's saturation on the corrected denominator), entropy_defect_delta non-zero and ARM-DEPENDENT (-0.056 ARM_OFF to -0.389 ARM_GNG) confirming the defect is real and does not cancel across arms; validate_recording --strict OK (always-core complete: recording_schema rec/v1, substrate_hash, machine_class, seeds, config, elapsed_seconds).

items.title: SD-049 ARM_2 curriculum/density repower (guard_pass load-bearing on joint arm)
items.note: Repowers V3-EXQ-793 (same 2x2 curriculum x density design, same ARM_2 substrate) per the confirmed autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-793_2026-07-24.{md,json}: 793 arm-level d3_clears (mean contact_rate) passed clean on A10/A01/A11 at n=3, but per-seed guard_pass showed real fragility not surfaced by the load-bearing criteria -- A11 (joint) failed guard_pass on 2/3 seeds, A01/A10 each on 1/3 -- thin, not decisive. Arm-fingerprint reuse of 793's own cells was considered and explicitly NOT wired up: 793 ran on ree-cloud-2 (torch2.12.0+cpu) and several substrate-touching changes have landed on main since its 2026-07-21 run (SD-081, ARC-071, MECH-048, SD-076) that near-certainly bust that fingerprint -- the expected near-zero reuse hit rate did not justify the added complexity on a lower-priority follow-up. SCOPE: this does NOT touch or lift SD-049's actual park (substrate_ceiling, gated on the foraging-competent-policy prerequisite for V3-EXQ-514, which this diagnostic neither tests nor addresses) -- informative curriculum/environment-design context only. Lower priority / optional per user instruction. episodes_per_run 340 is the AMENDED-arm length (793 convention); base arms (A00/A01) run 250, so runner ETA overestimates the base cells.
